stem: The communities in this list were established in America during the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries. What did they have in common?

options.label: A
options.text: They were dedicated to improving working conditions in factories.

options.label: B
options.text: They served as refuges for escaped slaves.

options.label: D
options.text: They were devoted to creating ideal societies.

visual_elements: • Brook Farm community members practiced plain living according to transcendentalist philosophy. • The Amana Colonies established a network of villages with an agricultural base. • Shakers practiced communal living, pacifism, and gender equality.
